finite_constants_to_replace.bad_fallback_children: At most32*N^2 per bad final leaf
finite_constants_to_replace.coefficient_data: Every fixed rational entry, inverse, determinant, prefix descriptor and height
finite_constants_to_replace.fixed_row_routes: R, original port charts and every internal matcher/inverse
finite_constants_to_replace.generic_affine_work: At most4*N^2-2*N basic shears per rank1 normalizer together with its inverse
finite_constants_to_replace.owned_storage: C, bounded by one owned bank per allocated finite unit instance

finite_template_hypothesis: Fixed integers N>=2,B>=1,P>=1 and a whole-cover native schematic uniform word, with P/B < N^(1-C0), final paid leaves of rank1, arbitrary productive inputs and separately owned storage.

prime_rule.also_required: Odd prime avoiding every fixed rational denominator, matcher determinant and chosen rank witness of the entire compiled word.

stock.asymptotic: Fixed compiled N,B,P: k=O_(N,B,q)(w*log e)=o(e), w=ceil(e^(3/1000)); pad high rows once by factor<2.
stock.depth_bound: D_N(n)=floor(log_N n) for rank<=floor(n/N) children; any larger explicit integer bound is safe.
stock.descendant_weights: Only final leaves are lowered. This outer cover row and role type become ancestor data; every next ordinary invocation has fresh disjoint role stock.
